steps.player: Wow! look at this place, it's so colourful.

steps.npc: Why thank you. Can I help you with anything?

steps.player: I take it by the clothes you are wearing and this room that you are in the dye trade?

options.text: Could you make some dye for me please?

steps.player: Can you make dyes for me please?

steps.npc: What colour dye do you want? I can make you blue, red or yellow dyes for you. If you bring me the correct raw materials.

options.text: What do you need to make red dye?

steps.player: What do you need to make red dye?

steps.npc: Hmm.... 3 lots of redberries should do the trick and 25 coins should cover any other costs.

options.text: Okay, make me some red dye please.

steps.text: If the player has less than three redberries:
You don't have enough berries to make the red dye.
If the player has less than 25 coins:
You don't have enough coins to pay for the dye.
If the player has sufficient gold and berries:

steps.player: Ok make me some red dye please.

steps.text: You hand the redberries and some coins to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a red bottle, which she then hands to you.
some red dye

options.text: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.

steps.player: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.

steps.npc: You know what you need to get, now come back when you have them. Goodbye for now.

options.text: I can do without dye at that price.

steps.player: I can do without dye at that price.

steps.npc: Fair enough, I still think that the price is fairly reasonable considering that I'm the only source of dye this side of the Shantay pass.

options.text: Where would I find a redberry bush?

steps.player: Where would I find a redberry bush?

steps.npc: Well you could try growing them. They shouldn't be too hard to grow.

steps.player: If I didn't care to grow my own, where else could I get some?

steps.npc: Well I know for sure that the desert climate wouldn't suit them. I have mine picked for me in the woods south of Varrock.

options.text: What do you need to make yellow dye?

steps.player: What do you need to make yellow dye?

steps.npc: Yellow is an awkward colour to recreate, I guess if you got me 2 onions I could use their skins to make a warm yellow dye for you. Oh yes and lest I forget I'll need 25 coins to cover the cost of the glass ware and

options.text: Okay, make me some yellow dye please.

steps.text: If the player has less than two onions:
You don't have enough onions to make the yellow dye.
If the player has less than 25 coins:
You don't have enough coins to pay for the dye.
If the player has sufficient gold and onions:

steps.player: Ok make me some yellow dye please.

steps.text: You hand two onions to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a yellow bottle, which she then hands to you.
some yellow dye

options.text: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
I can do without dye at that price.
Where could I find some onions?

steps.player: Where could I find some onions?

steps.npc: Generally you would find onions in vegetable gardens, silly.

steps.player: Ok you have me there but is there anywhere around here where I could get my hands on some onions?

steps.npc: I really don't know. A friend of mine grows hers on a farms near Draynor village. But that's a little far from here to be useful.

options.text: What do you need to make blue dye?

steps.player: What do you need to make blue dye?

steps.npc: To make a bottle of blue dye I'll need 2 woad leaves and 25 coins from you.

options.text: Okay, make me some blue dye please.

steps.text: If the player has less than two woad leaves:
You don't have enough woad leaves to make the blue dye.
If the player has less than 25 coins:
You don't have enough coins to pay for the dye.
If the player has sufficient gold and woad leaves:

steps.player: Ok make me some blue dye please.

steps.text: You hand the woad leaves and some coins to Rana, who then rummages around some shelves, eventually finding a blue bottle, which she then hands to you.
some blue dye

options.text: I don't think I have all the ingredients yet.
I can do without dye at that price.
Where can I get some woad leaves?

steps.player: Where can I get some woad leaves?

steps.npc: Woad leaves are fairly rare. My other customers tell me there's a gardener in Falador who grows them.

options.text: On second thoughts I don't really need any dye.

steps.player: On second thoughts, I don't think that I need some dye right now.

options.text: How did you get into the colour business?

steps.player: How did you get into the colour business?

steps.npc: Well, it's quite simple really my mother was a drysalter and I learnt the trade from her.

steps.player: Umm, what's a drysalter, it isn't a medical condition is it?

steps.npc: No silly, it's someone who deals with preservatives and dyes. I didn't really enjoy the preservative side of things so I've chosen to deal solely in dyeing.

steps.player: So how's business then?

steps.npc: It's a dyeing trade! Oh gosh, I'm sorry, that was a truly dreadful joke.

steps.player: Hmm yes, about the worst I've heard today at least.

steps.npc: Thanks. But really, it's not the best around here, nearly everyone in this town wears only white, which means I don't exactly do a roaring trade. Now is there anything I can get you?

options.text: Could you make some dye for me please?
No thanks, I'm just having a look around.

steps.player: No thanks, I'm just having a look around.
